title: Stop button contact replaced by a normally open block
summary: After maintenance a machine refuses to start although Start works electrically: the Stop circuit now reads 'pressed' all the time.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: After maintenance a machine refuses to start although Start works electrically: the Stop circuit now reads 'pressed' all the time.

troubleshooting.effect: The run condition never becomes true
symptoms: The Stop input LED is off while nobody presses Stop
The Stop input tag is FALSE in the input image
evidence: Voltage at the Stop input terminal with the button released (0 V instead of 24 V)
diagnosticMethod: Watch every input in the start condition while pressing Start
Compare the Stop input with the button state
Measure the terminal voltage with the button released and pressed
repair: Fit a normally closed contact block
troubleshooting.explanation: A normally closed Stop contact delivers 24 V at rest. A normally open block delivers 0 V at rest, which the program correctly interprets as 'Stop pressed'. The program is right; the hardware changed.
